cases.name: legacy-repo-incremental-adoption
cases.prompt: We turned on golangci-lint (v2, default standard linters plus gosec and errcheck) on a 6-year-old Go monorepo and got about 4,000 issues. Management wants the linter blocking in CI next week without freezing feature work. How do we roll it out?
cases.trap: Common bad answers: disable most linters, sprinkle //nolint everywhere, or set a huge max-issues; the targeted approach is linting only new code and cleaning up by category.
expectations: Recommends issues.new-from-rev (or new-from-merge-base / new-from-patch) so CI only fails on new or changed code
Proposes cleaning up existing findings incrementally, prioritising correctness/security categories such as gosec and errcheck
Advises against mass //nolint suppression of existing findings
negative_expectations: Recommends adding //nolint to every existing finding as the main strategy
Recommends disabling gosec or errcheck to make CI pass

cases.name: blanket-nolint-cleanup
cases.trap: Models often leave the bare //nolint or just append a reason; they also assume nolintlint already rejects bare/unexplained directives, which it does not unless configured.
expectations: Replaces the bare //nolint with one naming the specific linter (gosec) and rule context
Adds a justification after // on the directive, e.g. non-cryptographic jitter
Notes that nolintlint only flags missing linter names or explanations when require-specific / require-explanation are enabled in linters.settings.nolintlint
negative_expectations: Claims nolintlint with default settings already rejects this directive
Says nolintlint flags bare //nolint without mentioning require-specific/require-explanation

cases.name: Major-version install mismatch
cases.prompt: A project requires golangci-lint v2 config and its fmt subcommand. An onboarding script runs go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/cmd/golangci-lint@latest, then fails. Give a version-consistent installation plan.
cases.trap: Fetches v1 module when the tool/config assumes v2.
expectations: Recommends a version-pinned prebuilt v2 binary or the github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint module path.
Checks tool version/config compatibility before CI and avoids mixing v1/v2 semantics.
must_not: Does not keep the old v1 module import as the v2 install command.
